description: Public APIs from Singapore's national open-data platform cover real-time weather and traffic plus collection and dataset discovery and retrieval. They are accessible without an API key for testing; keys provide higher production limits. Current real-time APIs use api-open.data.gov.sg, while collection and dataset APIs use documented api-production.data.gov.sg and api-open.data.gov.sg routes.
